race.description: Manangatang Cup 10th October Book Now (Bm62) Hcp
race.comment: DECANTED (8) was on speed and fought on for second last start over 1200m at Echuca, making it three minor placings in a row. Drawn to enjoy a good run on the speed. Deserves a win and gets chance. ROYAL INFANTRY (2) built on a nice second two starts back at Ballarat Synthetic with a win over 1400m at Ballarat Synthetic three weeks ago, getting home by a head. Drawn for a soft run and will be tough to stop late. MAMUNO (10) is fitter for a solid return and expected to be in the finish this time. SHALAILED (5) has been thereabouts without winning but has been racing in richer races for a while, including the rich Topaz here five back when outclassed in the feature sprint. Gets chance to find best form.
